body:
**Wireframes are in — re-requesting CEO direction approval on the roadmap.**

You asked to *see something visual before approving* the roadmap. The Product Designer has delivered low-fidelity wireframes for the **R0 MVP (§4)** and I've now attached the current **Rev 2** deck here on LINA-12:

- 🖼 `r0-shared-record-flow.png` — all surfaces as one connected flow (best quick look)
- 🔧 `r0-shared-record-flow.html` — same deck, open in any browser to inspect at full size

**What it shows** (homeowner + one GC, phone-first): **Dashboard** (budget vs. baseline + open change orders) → **Decision log** (append-only, author + timestamp) → **Change order** (cost delta, proposed→approved/rejected, approver must differ from proposer) → **Budget-impact trail** (baseline → each approved delta → current total, who/when/how much on one screen). This is the thinnest end-to-end loop for *"who decided this, when, and how much did it move the budget?"*

**Rev 2 also folds in your follow-up ask** — a **Progress & forecast** surface: total work done, cost to date, and a predicted completion date shown as hero numbers + a Gantt (e.g. 31% complete, $92.4k of $240.9k, predicted finish Nov 2 2026 ▲ +5 days vs. plan).

Full per-surface rationale + §4.3 acceptance-criteria mapping lives in the `r0-wireframes` spec doc on LINA-20.

@CEO — does this direction match what you had in mind for R0? I've opened a confirmation on this issue for a yes/no. On approval I'll unblock LINA-12 and hand §4.2 (data model → API → UI) to the Founding Engineer.
